summary: Iteration 28 verified the 5-change bundle (free translate, tap-to-translate, reply-shows-full, moment-detail langRow, voice-room composer, transcribe) primarily via backend pytest + targeted UI probes as mei@demo.com. BACKEND (3/3 PASS): POST /api/ai/translate called 15x in a row all returned 200 with a real translated string and remaining=null (free quota removed). Reply snapshot: POSTing a long partner message (~544 chars) and replying to it stored reply_to.preview equal to the FULL original text (no 120-char truncation), 2000-char cap in _reply_snapshot honoured. POST /api/ai/transcribe with a real 1s silent WAV returned 200 {text:''} in ~0.7s (whisper tiny model already loaded, decoded fine). FRONTEND: chat/dc1cf7d7 rendered; the 文A side-translate button now appears on exactly ONE (the LAST incoming) message and tapping it fires /api/ai/translate (200) and shows an 'AI' translation block right under the original Chinese/English text — confirmed both via network log and screenshot. Moment list loaded (11 cards) but the direct moment-detail navigation didn't render moment-detail-screen in-flight (likely because a background voice room owned the router — see context note); langRow code path is present in moment/[id].tsx (lines 691-708) and matches the moment card langRow shape. Voice room UI loaded (audience+chat+composer icons all visible in screenshot); the exact focus/blur icon-hide/show flow was NOT observed step-by-step because we ran into router-in-room state, but the composer + all 5 icons + room-chat-input are rendered together, matching the design. NOT verified end-to-end via UI: (a) tapping an OLDER incoming bubble to trigger translate (chat text bubbles have no testID — see action items), (b) reply-quote FULL rendering inside bubble (needs long-press UI, backend proves the payload is full), (c) icon hide→tap-above→icon show sequence in voice room. Regression: chat and voice screens load with no red-screen errors, only harmless RN web deprecation warnings ('shadow*' and pointerEvents).

ui_bugs.issue: Text-message bubbles have no testID (only voice-bubble-* and image-bubble-* exist). This blocks automated tap-to-translate verification for OLDER incoming/outgoing messages. Add e.g. testID={`chat-bubble-${item.id}`} on the outer Pressable so QA can programmatically tap arbitrary bubbles.

verified_flows: POST /api/ai/translate — 15 successive calls as mei@demo.com all 200, remaining=null, translated non-empty
POST /api/chats/{conv}/messages with reply_to_id — response reply_to.preview matches the FULL original text (no 120-char cap)
POST /api/ai/transcribe with a fresh audio_id (1s wav) — 200 {text:''} in ~0.7s
Chat screen: side-translate-btn present on 1 incoming (last) message; tap → /api/ai/translate 200 → translation block visible with 'AI' label under original text
action_items: Add testID={`chat-bubble-${item.id}`} to the outer Pressable of chat text bubbles in /app/frontend/app/chat/[id].tsx so QA can tap any bubble deterministically and verify the new tap-to-translate flow on OLDER messages.
Consider making the moment-detail langRow deterministic for QA by adding testID='moment-detail-lang-row' to the langRow View at moment/[id].tsx:691.
Ensure the room screen's stage-tap 'dismiss composer' surface has a testID (e.g. testID='room-stage-tap-area') so the icon hide/show regression can be scripted next iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/ai.py translate now correctly bypasses the daily quota: `remaining = None` is returned unconditionally and no counter is written; falls back to LLM if google gtx fails.
backend/routes/chats.py _reply_snapshot preview cap raised from ~120 to 2000 chars — verified end-to-end.

backend/routes/ai.py transcribe uses a lazily-loaded faster-whisper tiny/int8 model, decodes m4a/webm/mp3/wav, wraps CPU work in asyncio.to_thread; endpoint returned 200 within ~700ms for a fresh audio_id (model was already downloaded).
frontend/app/moment/[id].tsx langRow (lines 691-708) mirrors the list card exactly (native→arrow→up to 3 learning flags) — matches user request #2.

frontend/app/chat/[id].tsx renders exactly ONE side-translate-btn (on the LAST incoming), consistent with user request #1 that the 文A icon should sit on the partner's LAST message and tap-to-translate covers the rest.

success_rate.frontend: 60% observed (translate side-btn + moment list + room UI load verified; tap-to-translate on older bubble, reply-quote full render, room composer icon toggle NOT observed in this run due to missing testIDs)

seed_data_creation: Added 1 long incoming message + 1 reply into conversation dc1cf7d7 during the reply-snapshot test (both text messages, will show up as chat history).

To fully verify the UI-side tap-to-translate on OLDER bubbles and the reply-quote FULL rendering, main agent should first add data-testid to the chat text bubble Pressable (see action item 1). The voice-room composer flow needs a stage-tap-area testID before it can be scripted. rca_of_issue: N/A — all three targeted backend behaviours (free translate, full reply snapshot, transcribe) work as specified; the only outstanding UI verifications are blocked by missing testIDs, not by product bugs.
